name: Amatsu Wakana
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c50660]Akito's[/url] classmate and close friend since middle school. He's very rich, his parents own the island on which the story takes place. He's extremely arrogant and loves to brag about his parents money, which is why he's disliked by most of his classmates and frequently gets into fights with Asuma. He's in love with Akito and is very open about it.
